name: znetwork_dplay_enum_session_callback_add_session_desc_cache
description: zNetworkDPlay::EnumSessionCallback_AddSessionDescCache is the DirectPlay EnumSessions callback that copies a session description, duplicates the session name, appends it to g_zNetwork_EnumeratedSessionList, and returns TRUE.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja renders the compiler-emitted GUID copy after the structure copy as split field assignments; source uses memcpy for the same 16-byte copy.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b5e0 validates the __stdcall four-argument callback ABI, null sessionDesc FALSE return, malloc(sizeof cache), 0x50-byte session description copy into cache->desc, 16-byte instanceGuid copy, _strdup of sessionName into cache->desc.sessionName, append through zArchiveList::PushBackPayload, and TRUE return.
The native smoke verifies null-session behavior, appended list count/node, copied scalar fields and GUIDs, duplicated sessionName ownership, preserved pointer fields, and custom status fields.
